items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: Red Dugas played with me when I first started, when I first put up the band.

ctx.x: Red Dugas played with me when I first started, when I first put up the band. But somehow they criticized him so much, I said poor Red, he quit himself. Is that right?
They kind of teased him or something? Criticized him? Yeah.
